Mr. Sandeep Adhikari, learned counsel 
for petitioner.
2. Mr. R.C. Joshi, learned Brief Holder for 
the State of Uttarakhand/respondents.
3. It is contended by learned counsel for 
petitioner that petitioner was working with 
respondent-Rural Development Department 
as Accountant, who was retired on 
30.11.2024.
4. Petitioner has challenged the order 
dated 30.05.2026 (Annexure No.5) passed 
by respondent No.4, whereby, an amount 
of ₹12,68,373/- was recovered from the 
petitioner.
5. It is contended by learned counsel for 
petitioner that petitioner’s pension has also 
been reduced pursuant to the aforesaid 
order passed by respondent No.4.
6. Learned State Counsel prays for and is 
granted four weeks’ time to file counter 
affidavit.
7. Put up on 01.09.2026.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
